 RRB ALP city intimation slip 2026 released for CBT 1; direct link to download here
 News | TOI Education | Oct 25, 2026, 14:28 IST RRB ALP city intimation slip 2026 released for CBT 1
 Save Comments Share The Railway Recruitment Boards (RRBs) have released the Assistant Loco Pilot (ALP) city intimation slip 2026 for the first-stage Computer-Based Test (CBT 1). The city intimation link is active for candidates appearing under CEN 01/2026. Candidates can check their allotted examination city through the official candidate login portal.
 Tired of too many ads? go ad free now The CBT 1 examination is scheduled to be held on November 3, 4 and 5, 2026. Candidates can check their examination city and date before the test to plan their travel arrangements.
 How to download the RRB ALP city intimation slip 2026
 Candidates can follow these steps to check their examination city:
 Visit the official RRB application portal or the examination city login page.
 Find the link for the RRB ALP CEN 01/2026 city intimation slip.
 Enter the required login details, such as the registration number and date of birth or password.
 Submit the details to access the city intimation slip.
 Check the allotted examination city and date.
 Download the slip and keep it for reference.
 Direct link here. 
 Candidates should check the details carefully and follow the instructions provided by the RRBs.
 Tired of too many ads? go ad free now RRB ALP admit card 2026 to be released separately
 Candidates should note that the city intimation slip is not the admit card. It provides advance information about the examination city and date so candidates can plan their travel.
 The RRBs have stated that e-call letters will be available approximately four days before the respective examination date. Candidates must download their admit cards separately and carry them to the examination centre.
 Eligible Scheduled Caste (SC) and Scheduled Tribe (ST) candidates can also use the designated login facility to download their travel authority, as applicable.
 Candidates are advised to check the official RRB websites regularly for further updates and instructions regarding the examination.
